name: EU PSD2 / PSD3 Payment Services & Open Banking Compliance
description: Compliance framework for the EU Payment Services Directive 2 (PSD2 - Directive 2015/2366), PSD3 proposals, and Payment Services Regulation (PSR), covering Strong Customer Authentication (SCA), Open Banking APIs (AISP/PISP), dynamic linking, and fraud reporting.
owner: EU Payment Services & Open Banking Governance Office

checklists.name: EU PSD2 / PSD3 Payment Security Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for EBA Regulatory Technical Standards (RTS) on SCA and CSC (Common and Secure Communication).

items.statement: Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) combines at least 2 independent elements from Knowledge, Possession, and Inherence.
Electronic payment transactions dynamically link the authentication code to the specific payee and transaction amount.
Dedicated Open Banking APIs (AISP/PISP) achieve identical uptime and response performance as customer-facing channels.
EBA fraud rate reporting statistics are submitted quarterly to national competent authorities.

reviewGates.name: EU PSD2 / PSD3 Payment Security Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Head of Payment Security confirms that SCA 2-factor, dynamic linking, and Open Banking APIs comply with PSD2 RTS.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the payment security audit evidence confirm full compliance with PSD2 / PSD3 RTS requirements?
